title: KCP artifact_upload_credential request (DESIGN.md §10.10, §11.6.1 read family)
description: Read: never mutates authoritative or user-visible state and never carries meta (closed shape — a read carrying meta, hence an idempotency key, fails; §11.2, R0 KENV-01). Non-mutating credential query (§10.10 spelled): reauthenticates the current actor plus all current upload dependencies, then returns a fresh short-lived provider credential for the already recorded staging key, byte ceiling, audience, and expiry. It may add only audit/rate accounting under §11.2. The credential grants no operation beyond the existing upload and never targets the canonical object (§10.10). Registry (shared_space_v1): surface external_client / principal; connector service (only for its mapped resources) (assurance: current login or workload identity). Surface and actor kind are registry-enforced, not schema-expressible (gap note KG14 for dual-surface ops).

args.description: Exact target by record id (§10.10 field name); every constraint of the credential was recorded at artifact_upload_begin (gap note KG29).

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).
